svg.title: Project Gantt chart
svg.desc: LabFlow: independent core delivery and gated enterprise integration. Bar length represents approximate relative workload. The axis represents abstract relative ordering, not calendar time. Blocked tasks have no invented relative offsets.
svg.text: LabFlow: independent core delivery and gated enterprise integration
Workload unit: relative work units · Bar length = approximate workload
Axis = relative position · No calendar duration

g.title: FIXTURE — Specify synthetic fixtures and independent reset protocol Preserve the source laboratory/user/device identities, qualification dates and clock baseline in a fixture manifest. Separate baseline, temporary-password, initialization, report and integration branches. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed fixture manifest and reset/clock specification. Acceptance criteria: LAB-A/LAB-B, USR-01..06, DEV-01..03, fixed names/codes/roles, 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z device creation and 2026-11-02T00:00:00Z initial clock are recorded faithfully., USR-07/08 are additional isolated fixtures only; baseline passwords are already set and baseline USR-05 qualifies for local emergency use., Each of source section 5 scenarios 1..32 has a reset/clock branch and planned evidence destination; synthetic tests and demos have distinct databases. PR scope: One small documentation PR for the fixture manifest and repeatable reset protocol. Resources: None

D_DATA — Design relational entities and transactional integrity Choose the minimal relational design and transaction strategy for stable entities, revisions, effective half-open occupancy, credential/session state, immutable audit, deduplication and outbox. Specify deadline convergence as a system operation after authentication/scope checks and before manual rules. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed schema, migration outline, transaction/race tables and invariants. Acceptance criteria: All minimum fields/relationships in source section 3, immutable IDs/laboratories/creation time and 409 version conflict behavior are mapped., Define atomic conflict protection for same-device reservations/maintenance, last organization administrator, grant uniqueness, successful idempotency keys and business/audit/outbox commits., Convergence preserves terminal states, survives failed manual transactions, cannot authorize out-of-scope effects, and makes read/list/availability/report results logically current., Architecture remains one server plus jobs and relational storage; review resolves necessary corrections before freeze. PR scope: One design PR for core persistence and transactional integrity; no platform-wide implementation. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer

D_API — Design authorization, API and list contracts Specify /api/v1/ endpoints, permitted role unions, scope/error matrix, password/session states, stable list contracts and safe summaries. Select a concrete repository/runtime without adding unapproved architecture. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed route, field, error, pagination and authentication contract with mock examples. Acceptance criteria: 401 unauthenticated, 404 foreign/sensitive out-of-scope records, 409 business/version conflicts and 422 located validation errors carry stable code/message/request correlation., Default 20/max 100 pagination, business-time descending plus immutable ID ordering, 100-character search and inclusive-local-date/exclusive-next-day conversion up to 90 days are explicit., No public signup, self-reset, batch approve/cancel/role-edit, new-laboratory entry, secrets in responses or name-based identity matching is introduced., Temporary-password lifetime, ordinary/local/enterprise separation and next-request permission changes are specified for every protected endpoint., Freeze qualification grant/revoke/read endpoints and their scoped administrator versus owner-read-only matrix, including validity inputs, current/history responses, duplicate grant conflicts, no direct validity edit and retained revocation consequences. Define authorized name editing of the two fixed laboratories within the reviewed administrator role/scope matrix; lab IDs, administrator scopes and historical device relations do not change, and no laboratory-create or device-lab-migration endpoint is added. PR scope: One core API/authentication contract PR with examples and reviewed scope matrix. Resources: backend-lead

D_STATE — Design reservation and maintenance state operations Write exact operation/state/precondition tables and transaction boundaries for reservation timing, qualifications, effective maintenance, emergency isolation and work orders. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed state-transition and adversarial-operation specification. Acceptance criteria: UTC ISO 8601 inputs, Asia/Shanghai displays, 08:00-20:00 including weekends, half-hour grid, 30-minute..8-hour same-day reservations and inclusive now+30-minute/start<=now+30*24-hour limits are explicit; end may exceed the start horizon., Pending expiry=min(created+24h,start), approved no_show=start+15m and in_use completion=end precede applicable manual rules, including failed reschedules and management operations., Owner cancellation differs from pre-start-only manager cancellation/rescheduling; registration uses [start,start+15m); automatic end is statistical/system-inferred, not hardware control., Maintenance may span days/closed hours; cancellation preserves original intervals and releases only remaining occupancy. Work-order transitions, eligibility, no closed editing and unresolved-emergency re-enable barrier are fixed. PR scope: One state/invariant design PR with race tables and boundary examples. Resources: backend-lead

D_NOTIFY — Review complete event and reminder delivery matrix Define every listed business event, non-sensitive message summary, event-time recipients, delivery authorization and reminder/compensation state. No recipient rule is delegated to unreviewed implementation choices. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed notification matrix and delivery/retry protocol. Acceptance criteria: Creation, approval, rejection, reschedule, cancellation, expiry, start, end, no_show, affected qualification revocation, fault and isolation events all have explicit recipients and summaries., Event-time enabled lab_manager/org_admin scope union is frozen, applicant result and actual-user isolation recipients are included, role-union duplicates removed; deactivation/revocation retaining in_use notifies scoped managers., Delivery skips disabled/lost-scope recipients without adding newly privileged users; skip differs from delivery failure; unique event/recipient/type is enforced., Start reminder requires unchanged slot, approved state and now<start on automated/restart/manual paths; 1/5/15-minute retries allow exactly three retries and failed events remain actionable. PR scope: One event/recipient/reminder contract PR including semantic review and examples. Resources: backend-lead

D_UI — Design Chinese pages, interactions and accessibility Specify the required Chinese page set, frozen-contract mocks, responsive forms/lists and dialog/keyboard behavior. User data stays plain text and protocol identifiers stay unchanged. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed UI flows and component/page state specification. Acceptance criteria: Directory/details/day view, reservation/self-list/use registration, work orders, messages, workbench, reports, audit, account and integration administration are accounted for., Loading, empty, field failure, permission refusal, version conflict, network failure and success states are specified at 360px and 1440px., Keyboard flow, associated labels/errors, focus-visible and non-color cues, dialog focus entry/return/Escape/close and deliberate approve/cancel confirmation are explicit; availability has an equivalent text list., Device administration explicitly includes scoped qualification grant/revoke controls with validity intervals, current/history display, deliberate revoke confirmation, conflict/permission feedback and no direct validity edit. Owners have read-only access to their own qualifications. Include authorized name-edit controls for the two existing labs, preserving fixed IDs and providing no lab-add or device-migration control. PR scope: One UI specification PR with mock fixtures and review corrections. Resources: frontend-lead
g.text: Reviewed UI flows and component/page sta…

g.title: D_OPS — Design local/test deployment and safe data operations Choose container/repository deployment, migrations and compatible rollback strategy, initialization authority, protected configuration/credential references, backup retention and restore procedure for the approved environment scope. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed deployment/migration/backup design and upgrade compatibility matrix. Acceptance criteria: Default external flags off; core liveness/database-write readiness and separate external degradation are defined., Ordinary initialization is idempotent; explicit authorized expired-initial-admin reset preserves ID/audit and does not bypass enterprise emergency guards., Daily data/config backup, protected separate credentials, latest seven copies, failure detection and blank-isolated recovery proof are specified with <=24-hour loss and <=60-minute target., Upgrade requires verified backup and compatible schema/application versions; destructive migration is explicitly handled rather than assuming application rollback restores data. Logs retain 30 days while history/audit/messages are not auto-deleted. PR scope: One deployment and data-operations design PR with reviewed migration/rollback plan. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer

CORE_FROZEN — Approve and freeze core implementation contracts Record accepted prerequisites and the explicit internal approval state. No additional implementation is hidden in this gate. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Approve and freeze core implementation contracts approval record Acceptance criteria: All six positive-work design PRs are accepted/merged, review corrections resolved and contracts explicitly frozen; mock implementations may now use them. PR scope: No code PR; approval state only. Resources: None
g.text: Approve and freeze core implementation c…

g.title: D_PERF — Review and freeze performance acceptance method Business and technical acceptance representatives review workload mix, pacing, warmup, critical endpoint coverage, metric groups, expected-error sample rules and selected test tool before formal execution. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Approved reproducible A/B performance protocol and evidence templates. Acceptance criteria: Fix 1,000 enabled users/200 devices/100,000 historical reservations/20,000 orders/200,000 messages, separate 4-vCPU/8-GiB server and database, 50 logged-in sessions and ten-minute measured load after specified warmup., Exclude only external interfaces and export from query/write latency thresholds: p95 query<=500ms, write<=800ms, unexpected server errors<1%; expected authorization/business conflicts are separately counted., Critical query/write API families, samples and indexes/day-view/self-list behavior are covered; B additionally tests real integration timeout/degradation. Method changes require renewed review, preserving all fixed conditions. PR scope: One performance-method design PR with review/signature records and sample-report schema. Resources: None

PERF_FROZEN — Approve frozen formal performance method Record accepted prerequisites and the explicit internal approval state. No additional implementation is hidden in this gate. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Approve frozen formal performance method approval record Acceptance criteria: Business and technical representatives approve the complete method before either formal performance run. PR scope: No code PR; approval state only. Resources: None

ASSET_READY — Asset sandbox materials are delivered External materials supplied by the fictional client; the internal team does not estimate their production as an implementation task. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Asset sandbox materials are delivered Acceptance criteria: Sandbox, API documents, test token and real sample assets are usable; readiness is the explicit T+6 abstract-axis assumption. PR scope: No code PR; outside delivery event. Resources: None

IDENTITY_READY — Real OIDC materials and three account classes are delivered External materials supplied by the fictional client; the internal team does not estimate their production as an implementation task. Status: Blocked (external readiness unknown: IDENTITY_READY) Deliverable: Real OIDC materials and three account classes are delivered Acceptance criteria: Provider metadata, registered callback, protected client credentials and real linked-enabled, linked-disabled and unlinked sandbox accounts are all usable; no simulated account fills a missing class. PR scope: No code PR; outside delivery event. Resources: None
g.text: Real OIDC materials and three account cl…

g.title: ENV — Prepare isolated shared verification environment Provision repeatable local/isolated-test containers and independent test/demo data stores, controlled clock and reset entry points; reserve the sole formal QA environment. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Versioned environment bootstrap and reset commands. Acceptance criteria: Fresh test database setup/reset works independently from the demo database; time advancement is test-only., Configured service/database resources match the frozen hardware targets when used for performance; secrets are excluded from examples., Formal integration, end-to-end, performance, recovery and upgrade/rollback work waits for ENV, and each holds qa-shared-env for its full interval. PR scope: One environment-tooling PR; no core business or persistence-model fixes. Resources: qa-shared-env

DB_CORE — Implement core migrations and invariants Implement the reviewed core schema, migrations and database integrity mechanisms; integration binding tables remain a separate B migration PR. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Core relational migrations and migration/invariant tests. Acceptance criteria: Stable entity fields, unique device codes, immutable relationships/creation time, versions, append-only audit and event/key uniqueness follow frozen design., Effective occupancy, qualification uniqueness and last-organization-administrator protections have executable transaction mechanisms and rollback tests., Fresh install and supported forward/compatible prior-app behavior are tested; no destructive rollback assumption is hidden. PR scope: One persistence PR for core schema/migrations and database-level tests. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer

SERVER_BASE — Implement server clock, protocol and transactional events Implement the minimal API skeleton, controlled server clock, error/correlation format, stable pagination and transactional audit/outbox helpers over the frozen schema. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reusable core server infrastructure with local tests. Acceptance criteria: All /api/v1/ failures use frozen 401/404/409/422 semantics and correlation IDs; UTC/local conversion and stable pagination are tested., Business/audit/outbox success is all-or-nothing; denied/invalid attempts enter redacted security logs instead of successful business audit., Outbox creation snapshots matrix-defined recipients at commit time; a later delivery failure cannot roll back a successful transaction., Helpers are usable by downstream modules; incomplete public business routes remain unavailable. PR scope: One server-foundation PR with unit and transaction-helper tests, no unapproved layers. Resources: backend-lead

AUTH_LOCAL — Implement local credentials, sessions and initialization Deliver login/logout, administrator account creation and force reset, password setting, initialization and explicit expired-initial-admin recovery. Account deactivation closure is supplied by ACCOUNT_DISABLE. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Local authentication APIs/commands and controlled-clock security tests. Acceptance criteria: Hash passwords irreversibly, protect Cookie sessions, revoke on logout/reset, enforce idle 30 minutes/absolute 12 hours and five failures followed by ten-minute suspension without account enumeration., Temporary password is manually handed over, not emailed/logged/stored plaintext; pre-change sessions allow only change/logout, expire no later than issue+24h and normal session limits., Logout/timeout do not consume valid temporary credentials; successful change/re-reset invalidates prior credentials and never resurrects old sessions., Test separate source scenario 12 branches at issue+23h59m and exactly+24h without earlier idle/absolute expiry interference. Ordinary init twice changes no credentials/entities; authorized expired-admin recovery keeps ID/audit., Local password state does not block future enterprise authentication; account disable is unavailable until its transactional PR is accepted. PR scope: One local-authentication/initialization PR with safe commands, tests and security notes. Resources: backend-lead

AUTH_SCOPE — Implement roles, scope and organization administrator guards Enforce role unions/current lab scope across server operations and organization-only administration. Bind the core concurrent last-admin guard to account/role management. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Authorization services and direct-API matrix tests. Acceptance criteria: Four roles across both labs permit/refuse expected operations; next-request changes apply without re-login, auditor writes and own approvals are refused., Missing/foreign sensitive targets consistently return 404 after authentication; rejected writes change no business state., Concurrent role removals/deactivations cannot leave zero enabled org_admin users; enterprise emergency-qualified protection is added in ID_MODE before B activation. PR scope: One authorization PR with direct API tests and concurrent core administrator protection. Resources: backend-lead

STATE_CLOCK — Implement deadline-first reservation convergence Implement internal due-state convergence and compensating jobs for pending expiry, no-show and automatic completion before dependent public actions are enabled. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Clock-aware state engine and idempotent due-work tests. Acceptance criteria: At min(created+24h,start), start+15m and planned end, pending/approved/in_use become expired/no_show/completed with occupancy release and one audit/event each., Authenticate and authorize manual targets first; failed later manual actions retain system convergence and cannot restore earlier states or overwrite terminal history., Automatic end statistics use planned end, retaining processing time and inferred source; end+20m delay or late manual request adds no use minutes., Read/list/availability/report convergence contract works with database fixtures; old tasks cannot overwrite in_use/next reservation or emit duplicate counts/messages. PR scope: One internal state-engine/job PR with controlled-clock and race tests; no incomplete public action routes. Resources: backend-lead

DEVICE — Implement device catalog and guarded lifecycle Implement scoped device create/edit/enable/ordinary disable/detail/search with immutable lab/ID/creation time and reviewed policy guards. Re-enable checks current work-order data even before order creation is exposed. Deliver authorized name editing for the two fixed laboratories against the frozen administrator scope contract, with unchanged lab IDs and existing device/history/scope relationships. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Device and fixed-laboratory-name APIs with lifecycle, stable-relationship, version and authorization tests. Acceptance criteria: Duplicate organization device codes conflict; device-name edits retain device ID/creation time; device laboratory reassignment and device deletion entry are absent, and bound external code/name/location edits are refused., Ordinary disable converges deadlines then rejects pending/approved/in_use with authorized conflict details; maintenance is retained and does not itself block disable., Approval/qualification policy changes reject effective occupying reservations but allow due terminal records after convergence. Re-enable never restores cancelled reservations and rejects unresolved emergency orders., Requesters see enabled devices only, managers can filter disabled ones, stable Chinese/special-character search and versions follow the shared contracts., Authorized administrators can rename either existing laboratory only within the frozen role/scope matrix. Direct unauthorized requests are refused; renaming keeps lab ID, fixed two-lab membership, administrator scope references and device/reservation/history relationships unchanged. No new-laboratory entry or device migration is introduced. PR scope: One catalog/lifecycle and fixed-lab metadata PR over the existing reviewed schema, with local transaction and authorization tests. Resources: backend-lead

QUALIFICATION — Implement grants and revocation consequences Deliver scoped grant/read/revoke operations and transactional reservation effects using the frozen qualification invariants. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Qualification APIs with race/history tests. Acceptance criteria: At most one unrevoked unexpired qualification per user/device; full requested interval must be covered and direct validity edit is rejected., Revoke converges due states first, atomically cancels still-valid unregistered pending/approved reservations and releases occupancy; in_use remains and scoped managers receive handling events., Grant/revoke audit survives history; regrant never revives terminal reservations. Revocation/approval race cannot result in an approved reservation without qualifying coverage. PR scope: One qualification PR including revocation transaction and local concurrent tests. Resources: backend-lead

RESERVE_CREATE — Implement validated occupancy and creation service Implement the internal creation service and privacy-safe daily occupancy projection over effective half-open intervals. The public create route waits for the idempotent request boundary. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Transactional reservation creation and availability services with tests. Acceptance criteria: Enforce source section 3 opening/day/grid/duration/start horizon and purpose 1..500, device enable, full qualification, stable server-generated requester/ID and pending versus automatic-approved status., Twenty distinct-user same-device/same-slot contenders have one winner; different devices succeed independently and adjacent slots do not conflict., Failed validation/conflict leaves no reservation/audit/delivery event; successful mutation commits all three., Other requesters see only occupied times and an occupied label, never foreign requester/purpose/reservation ID; owner/scoped managers get allowed detail, maintenance and due states are reflected. PR scope: One occupancy/creation-service PR with local transaction tests; public create remains gated until RESERVE_KEY. Resources: backend-lead

RESERVE_KEY — Expose idempotent reservation creation Add the public create route with normalized-body Idempotency-Key handling and exact first-success response retention. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Creation API with retry/concurrent-key tests. Acceptance criteria: Within 24h, same user/route/key/body replays the same ID and first successful result without revalidating successful creation; different body is 409 and different users are independent., Only a successful commit consumes the key; corrected failed requests can retry, >24h is new work, and concurrent same-key arrivals commit once., Network timeout replay adds no reservation, business audit or notification event; stale reservation versions remain conflict-safe. PR scope: One API-boundary PR for idempotent creation and race/replay tests. Resources: backend-lead

RESERVE_ACTIONS — Implement approval, cancellation and atomic rescheduling Deliver scoped reasoned approval/rejection and owner/manager cancellation/rescheduling endpoints after due-state convergence. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reservation action APIs with state/race/rollback tests. Acceptance criteria: Approval rejects self, wrong scope, expiry/deadline, disabled device or insufficient qualification; rejection needs a reason and releases occupancy. Approval versus due-worker resolves once without stale override., Owner cancellation at start+5m while still approved succeeds; manager ordinary cancellation and owner rescheduling at/after start fail, regardless of valid target slot; at start+15m terminal no_show wins., Reschedule keeps device, validates a fresh request, returns pending/recalculates expiry when approval required, atomically releases old slot only on success and preserves converged original state/version on failure., Competing reschedules/maintenance cannot double-book; successful changes increment version and produce exactly one result event, stale requests return 409. PR scope: One reservation-action PR with local concurrency and precise deadline tests. Resources: backend-lead

RESERVE_USE — Implement owner registration and use completion Expose owner-only use-start and manual completion over the clock state engine, with viewable planned/actual/statistical timestamps. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Use-operation APIs and clock/race tests. Acceptance criteria: Register approved use exactly at start but not at start+15m; owner-only, no early/repeated start, and enabled device/full qualification/no exclusive maintenance are rechecked atomically., Manual end before end accepts 0..500-character notes and uses server time; at/after end first converges automatic completion without overwriting planned statistical end/source/processing time., Manual/automatic race emits one completion and preserves history; next adjacent reservation registers at end without waiting for prior user action. No fee, hardware-stop or measured-hardware claim is added. PR scope: One reservation-use PR with local event/race tests and detail fields. Resources: backend-lead

MAINTENANCE — Implement maintenance conflicts and remaining-interval cancellation Deliver scoped maintenance create/view/cancel with immutable original intervals and effective remaining occupancy. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Maintenance APIs with interval and transaction tests. Acceptance criteria: Positive half-hour-grid windows start no earlier than now, may span closed hours/days and exceed reservation 30-day horizon., Reservation/maintenance and maintenance/maintenance overlap rejects atomically; adjacent half-open intervals succeed and authorized conflicts are shown without silently cancelling reservations., Before end cancellation uses current non-rounded server time, preserves original start/end/reason/audit and frees only remainder; ended cancellation fails, disabled devices stay disabled and new reservations still obey lead/grid rules. PR scope: One maintenance PR with local concurrent interval/cancellation tests. Resources: backend-lead
g.text: Maintenance APIs with interval and trans…

g.title: WORK_ORDERS — Implement reporting, handler history and explicit workflow Implement visible-device fault report and scoped work-order actions, linked recurrence and current handler authorization; reporting never isolates automatically. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Work-order APIs and full transition-matrix tests. Acceptance criteria: Report requires 1..1000-character description and ordinary/emergency priority, creates open order and manager event without attachment or auto-disable., Permit open->in_progress, open/in_progress->resolved, resolved->closed or in_progress; closed cannot reopen/edit, recurrence creates linked new order and closure requires summary., Handler must currently be enabled scoped lab_manager/org_admin; changed/deactivated handlers lose action access without losing assignment history and valid same-scope managers can reassign., Reporter sees own status/non-internal summary. Open/in_progress emergency orders block separate audited re-enable; ordinary orders do not, resolution/closure never enables automatically. PR scope: One fault/work-order workflow PR with state, version and handler-authorization tests. Resources: backend-lead

ISOLATION — Implement atomic emergency isolation Deliver explicit emergency-isolation operation as the documented exception to ordinary disable, over converged reservation states. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Isolation API and rollback/recipient tests. Acceptance criteria: One transaction disables the device, cancels valid unregistered pending/approved records and releases occupancy; due no_show/completed states are retained., In_use records remain with actual-user stop-use and scoped-manager notices; no physical hardware shutdown is asserted., Injected transaction failure preserves all original device/reservation state; all histories remain and re-enable still obeys independent emergency-order barrier. PR scope: One isolation PR with local failure injection and due-state tests. Resources: backend-lead

ACCOUNT_DISABLE — Close transactional account deactivation Enable account deactivation only when its session, reservation and handler consequences can commit together. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Deactivation/reactivation APIs with atomicity tests. Acceptance criteria: After due convergence, atomically deactivate/revoke all sessions/cancel valid unregistered pending/approved reservations, releasing their occupancy., Retain in_use/history/qualifications/work orders, notify scope managers, deny inactive historical handlers and allow current eligible reassignment., Failure injection leaves no partial deactivation. Reactivation restores neither cancelled bookings nor old sessions; existing use still ends at its deadline., Unique enabled-org-admin guard holds concurrently; ID_MODE must additionally protect the last qualified emergency administrator before enterprise activation. PR scope: One account-lifecycle closure PR with source scenario 13 and concurrent core guard tests. Resources: backend-lead

MESSAGE_DELIVERY — Implement durable authorized message delivery Consume frozen-recipient outbox events into owner messages with delivery-time account/scope rechecks and idempotent read APIs. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Delivery worker, message APIs and recipient/race tests. Acceptance criteria: Unique event/recipient/type prevents duplicate messages across worker/manual consumers; role unions do not duplicate a recipient., Old managers losing scope are skipped with evidence, new managers are not appended, other originally eligible managers deliver normally and pure auditor status creates no business notification., Delivery failures preserve committed business state; unread filtering/counts and single/all read actions are owner-only/idempotent., Historical summaries remain non-sensitive, target clicks recheck current access and missing targets are explicit. PR scope: One message-delivery and owner-message API PR with local worker/permission tests. Resources: backend-lead
g.text: Delivery worker, message APIs and recipi…

g.title: REMINDERS — Implement bounded retries and stale-reminder compensation Add start reminder scheduling, bounded retry, restart compensation and manual event redelivery with one eligibility predicate. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reminder/retry jobs and failure-injection tests. Acceptance criteria: Approved reminder schedules once at start-30m or immediately within window; approval after start is refused., Retry delays are exactly 1/5/15 minutes with three retries maximum, then pending handling; multiple workers/manual retry remain duplicate-safe and event correlation is preserved., Every automatic/restart/manual delivery requires approved, same slot and now<start plus recipient authorization; cancel/reschedule/registration/start/terminal state invalidates old undelivered reminders., Reapproved new slot gets one new reminder; old delivered history persists and current permissions still govern target access. PR scope: One reminder-compensation PR with controlled-clock restart/manual redelivery tests. Resources: backend-lead

QUERY_WORKBENCH — Implement scoped lists and manager workbench Complete real list/detail/filter projections for users and managers with stable pagination and safe availability privacy. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Read APIs and scope/filter/page tests. Acceptance criteria: Device name/code, self reservation status/device/date and manager/order lab/status/priority filters enforce 100-character search and <=90 local-day conversion., Default 20/max100 pages sort business time descending then ID; same data version has no missing/duplicate rows and every page retains authorization., Workbench contains pending, approved starts in [now,now+2h), in_use, unclosed orders and future maintenance; org_admin lab filter never expands a lab_manager scope., Due-state reads and privacy projections match server state; no bulk action endpoints are added. PR scope: One scoped-query/workbench PR over accepted business modules with local API tests. Resources: backend-lead

REPORTS — Implement state-aware weighted utilization reports Implement scoped and auditor-read-only aggregation using logical due states, clipped actual use and post-device-creation open-window denominators. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Report APIs, reviewed query indexes and deterministic arithmetic tests. Acceptance criteria: Counts use scheduled-start local date; planned minutes include only completed planned intervals, actual minutes use registered start/statistical end clipped to boundaries, excluding worker delay and no_show., The denominator is the intersection of the report range, daily opening windows and time on or after immutable device creation. A report range entirely before creation has zero denominator and no-computable-data; creation within a day clips that day at creation. Creation before a later report range does not zero its opening-window denominator. Disable and maintenance never subtract denominator., Source scenario 23 yields DEV-03 40/720, DEV-LATE 30/600, LAB-B 70/1320 and 120 completed planned minutes, not averaged percentages., Time zone/metric explanation is returned, rename/sync preserves historical attribution and creation time; indexes/pagination cover large day-view/self-list queries. PR scope: One reporting/query-index migration PR on reviewed schema, with db-reviewer covering index/migration changes. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer
g.text: Report APIs, reviewed query indexes and…

g.title: CSV — Implement safe scoped report export Expose audited UTF-8 CSV device/local-date aggregates using the same report filters/scope and bounded output. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Export API and CSV safety/permission tests. Acceptance criteria: Managers/auditors only; no requester identity or purpose fields. >10,000 rows rejects with smaller-range guidance instead of truncation., Text starting =,+,-,@ is safely escaped, true numeric values remain numeric and quotes/commas/newlines follow CSV format., Column names/time zone/statistical meanings are explicit; output row count matches filtered UI result and export audit correlates the request. PR scope: One report-export PR with local formula/text edge-case and authorization tests. Resources: backend-lead
g.text: Export API and CSV safety/permission tes…

g.title: AUDIT_OPS — Implement audit queries, health and core operations Deliver authorized audit filters, process/database checks, correlated redacted logging and core backlog/failure operations queries. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Audit/health/operations APIs and retention tests. Acceptance criteria: Audit filters date/action/actor enforce org_admin/auditor scope; no business edit/delete APIs. Passwords/tokens/external credential values never enter logs/summaries., Business history/audit/messages are never auto-deleted; security/runtime logs age out after 30 days only., Database read/write outage fails readiness and recovery passes; liveness is distinct and external failure cannot fail core readiness., Authorized operations show pending/failed delivery events and correlation IDs; unauthenticated/out-of-role access is rejected. PR scope: One audit/core-operations PR with local fault/retention tests; B integration state additions are separate. Resources: backend-lead

DEPLOY_A — Package repeatable core deployment and migration commands Package accepted core APIs/jobs with local/test containers, secret-free variables, migrations, health verification, initialization and explicit credential-recovery procedures. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reproducible core deployment commands and smoke tests. Acceptance criteria: Fresh environment boots with external flags off; source scope excludes production infrastructure and continuous on-call., Two ordinary initializations add no duplicate roles/devices and reset no existing credentials; explicit authorized admin recovery preserves ID/audit., Migration/application compatibility and verified-backup prerequisites are documented; downgrade cannot claim to recover destructive data by itself. PR scope: One deployment/migration-packaging PR with migration review and local smoke tests. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer

BACKUP — Implement protected backups, retention and recovery commands Build data/config backup and restore tooling, daily scheduling and failure discovery without changing application server or schema. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Backup/restore scripts and protected configuration examples. Acceptance criteria: Latest seven backups retained independently of 30-day logs; credentials protected separately and no usable secrets in samples., Manual blank-environment restore and failure-discovery steps are executable; manifests expose source time/coverage for <=24h loss proof., Tool tests use synthetic data and never delete business/audit/message history as retention cleanup. PR scope: One operations-script PR; no server/model changes and no formal recovery result claimed yet. Resources: None

UI_BASE — Implement Chinese feedback and keyboard primitives Implement the approved minimal browser shell, Chinese status labels, escaped text display, form error associations and safe dialog focus controls. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reusable UI primitives and component tests. Acceptance criteria: Protocol values/IDs remain stable while visible labels use Simplified Chinese; user strings are plain text., Named fields/linkable errors, visible focus/non-color statuses and dialogs with focus entry/return/Escape/explicit close work without accidental background confirmation., Component examples cover loading/empty/error/conflict/success at narrow/wide widths. PR scope: One small frontend primitives PR; downstream page PRs use frozen mocks. Resources: frontend-lead
g.text: Reusable UI primitives and component tes…

g.title: UI_ACCOUNTS — Implement local login and scoped account administration pages Build login/logout, restricted password-change and organization account/role/scope views with frozen mocks. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Chinese authentication/account pages and component tests. Acceptance criteria: Restricted login exposes only password-change/logout, session errors and expiration feedback; no public signup/self-reset appears., Org-only account create/reset/deactivate/role/scope controls show conflict/forbidden feedback without replacing server authorization., Long names, keyboard forms/dialogs and 360px/1440px layouts are usable. UI_DIRECTORY — Implement device directory and accessible daily availability Build search/filter directory, details, scoped device administration and daily intervals with privacy-safe mock projections. Include scoped administrator qualification grant/revoke and fixed-laboratory-name editing within device administration, against the frozen mock API. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Chinese device/day-view, scoped qualification-management and fixed-lab-name controls with responsive keyboard/component tests. Acceptance criteria: Unknown/disabled/bound read-only and policy/version conflicts are explicit; no delete/lab-migration entry is provided., Foreign occupied intervals reveal no identity/purpose/ID; day chart has equivalent keyboard-readable text list and adjacent boundaries display correctly., Search/page/filter changes clear stale-scope cache and preserve safe plain-text long Chinese labels at 360px/1440px., Eligible scoped administrators can grant with explicit validity interval, inspect current and historical qualification, and deliberately revoke with occupancy/in-use consequence feedback; scope denial, duplicate grant and version conflicts are shown. There is no direct validity editing, and revoke/regrant never implies cancelled reservations revive. Owner qualification display remains read-only and limited to the owner., Authorized administrators can edit names of the two fixed labs with explicit success/validation/permission/conflict states. Labels refresh while stable lab IDs, scope selections, device ownership and historical links persist; no lab creation or device migration control is offered. PR scope: One coherent device-administration/day-view frontend PR with qualification and fixed-lab-name controls against frozen mocks; no new standalone page or backend fixes. Resources: frontend-lead

g.title: D_IDENTITY — Design OIDC validation, linking and authentication modes Review concrete OIDC callback/security checks, protected credential references, stable trusted identity source, one-to-one linking data, local/enterprise session modes and concurrent emergency-admin guard. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed OIDC/linking/security and mode-transition contract. Acceptance criteria: Org_admin-only first association to an existing enabled internal user uses trustworthy stable identity, never email/display-name matching; identical linking is idempotent and different existing associations conflict without data changes., No automatic accounts/roles, unlink/rebind/migration, enterprise-wide logout or upstream-disable push; internal role/scope authority and session limits remain intact, enterprise-only users need no local password., Define actual callback tamper/expiry/missing-field/duplicate validation, simulator environment isolation and linked-enabled/linked-disabled/unlinked cases., Enterprise enable revokes ordinary local sessions and requires enabled password-set org_admin; deactivation/role loss/force reset guard the last qualified emergency administrator concurrently., Provider outage preserves enterprise mode/valid local-lifetime enterprise sessions; explicit close revokes enterprise sessions, switches local, retains relationships and requires manual temporary-password recovery where absent. PR scope: One OIDC/security/data-contract design PR including review corrections; real external details remain unknown. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer

D_ASSET — Design asset mapping, ownership and source-time transactions Freeze cursor asset field normalization, explicit stable-lab mapping, immutable first binding, new-device defaults and source-time acceptance atomicity. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed asset API/data and binding/integrity contract. Acceptance criteria: Fields asset_id/code/name/location/updated_at and stable UTC/time normalization are defined; mapping is org_admin-only and never guessed from name/location., New valid mapped asset creates one disabled/approval-required/qualification-required device; absent mapping fails one item and other legal items continue. Bound map cannot migrate lab., Source older=skip, equal/same fields=skip, equal/different=conflict, newer=atomic apply; failures keep prior watermark/fields and duplicate pages preserve creation time/local flags., Explicit existing-device first binding atomically validates lab, code/fields and both one-to-one directions; failure rolls back association and fields. No code merge/unlink/rebind/delete is added. PR scope: One asset contract/integrity design PR with transaction examples and review corrections. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer

D_SYNC — Design bounded asset batches and confirmed recovery Freeze cursor/checkpoint representation, batch lifecycle, retry classification, admin continuation, invalid-checkpoint human confirmation and safe scheduled resume. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed sync batch/recovery protocol with fault tables. Acceptance criteria: Exactly one running or waiting-retry batch; repeated triggers return it. Daily 02:00 Asia/Shanghai, up to three 1/5/15-minute retries and terminal failure releases slot., Auth/field failures are not blindly retried; valid items continue. Manual retry is a linked new batch from a valid checkpoint retaining commits., Invalid checkpoint ends original batch with evidence and blocks scheduled implicit rescan; only org_admin confirmation creates linked full-rescan batch preserving mappings/bindings/watermarks/creation times/successes., Repeated checkpoint failure demands another confirmation; successful full pagination restores schedule despite per-item field errors. Core readiness remains independent. PR scope: One batch/cursor/recovery design PR; no estimates replace external materials. Resources: backend-lead

D_B_UI_OPS — Design integration pages and protected B deployment/recovery Review B integration API/UI states, protected credentials, binding-data backup, migration compatibility, emergency local entry and safe feature activation sequence. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Reviewed B page/operations/migration addendum. Acceptance criteria: Integration status distinguishes running, waiting retry, failed, pending human recovery/linked recovery, provider outage and explicit identity-off; neither degrades core readiness., Chinese pages never echo secret values, permit organization administration only and cover full keyboard/responsive/error states., External flags stay off until A release, with backup/restore and upgrade/rollback proof for identity/asset bindings before real use; incomplete external materials halt real steps safely., Deployment explains emergency qualification, authorized mode changes, no-password local recovery, no guard bypass by init and true B real-evidence requirements. PR scope: One cross-module B API/UI/operations design addendum PR with migration/data-integrity review. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer

B_FROZEN — Approve and freeze enterprise implementation contracts Record accepted prerequisites and the explicit internal approval state. No additional implementation is hidden in this gate. PR scope: No code PR; approval state only. Resources: None

DB_BINDINGS — Implement identity and asset binding migrations Implement reviewed one-to-one identity/asset associations, stable mappings/source watermarks and traceable sync batch/checkpoint records, with safe compatible migration. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: B migrations and uniqueness/compatibility tests. Acceptance criteria: Both association directions remain unique and permanent even for inactive accounts; data model preserves internal ID/lab/creation time and protected credential references., Batch/checkpoint/recovery associations and source-time transactions support frozen invariants; migration preserves A data and compatible rollback boundary., No features automatically enable during migration and no existing entity is merged by email/code/name. PR scope: One B persistence/migration PR with db-reviewer and executable integrity tests. Resources: backend-lead, db-reviewer

ID_LINK — Implement administrator-only immutable identity linking Deliver first-link administration and internal account/session lookup without relying on real provider readiness. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Identity-link APIs and synthetic identity tests. Acceptance criteria: Only org_admin links verified stable identity to a precreated enabled account; same association replays safely and different association/ordinary-user request rejects without partial state., One-to-one retained binding survives deactivation; no unlink/rebind/auto-account/automatic admin role/email merge exists., Enterprise account with no local password is not blocked by local pending-password state; changes are redacted audited and UI/API secrets never leak. PR scope: One identity-association PR with local contract/transaction tests; capability remains integration-gated. Resources: backend-lead

ID_CALLBACK_MOCK — Implement OIDC callback and isolated provider simulator Implement frozen OIDC validation/session adapter and local development/test provider, with detached test setup before A activation. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: OIDC callback adapter and simulator/security test suite. Acceptance criteria: Linked enabled succeeds, linked disabled/unlinked reject; expiry/tamper/missing fields/duplicate identity/wrong response cannot create success or bypass core authorization., No local password is needed for valid enterprise authentication; logout revokes only current LabFlow session and new logins authenticate with provider., Simulator enabled only in development/test, no public bypass/default-password path; real provider selection remains gated until B_ACTIVATE plus real materials. PR scope: One OIDC callback/simulator PR with demanding security validation and integration-disabled default. Resources: backend-lead

ID_MODE — Implement safe enterprise mode and emergency credentials Implement transactional mode enable/disable, session origin revocation and last locally password-set emergency org_admin protection. Status: Scheduled Deliverable: Mode/configuration APIs and security/concurrency tests. Acceptance criteria: Enable rejects absent qualified emergency org_admin and temporary-password-only/lab_manager accounts; revokes ordinary local sessions and closes ordinary local login/reset while retaining strict emergency entry., Concurrent disable/demotion/force-reset cannot remove last eligible emergency admin; initialization recovery cannot bypass guard, replacement must first complete local password setting., Provider outage keeps enterprise mode and valid existing enterprise sessions until local idle/absolute timeout; no automatic local fallback., Explicit org_admin close revokes enterprise sessions, returns local mode without booking/history/identity changes, never automatically issues passwords; absent-password user receives manual temp credential/change and retains same ID/history. Re-enable rechecks eligibility. PR scope: One authentication-mode PR with source scenarios 14/25/26 synthetic security tests; real verification later. Resources: backend-lead

Bound code/name/location local write is refused and no deletion/code merge/unlink/rebind occurs., Older/equal-same/equal-different/newer order produces skip/skip/conflict/apply; illegal fields/code collisions keep old fields/watermark, duplicate pages preserve creation time., Existing-device first binding validates lab/unique relations/code and atomically applies fields; both relationship/field partial effects roll back on any conflict. PR scope: One asset ownership/application PR with source scenarios 27-29 local transaction tests. Resources: backend-lead

PR scope: One sync-recovery/observability PR with source scenario 31 local fault tests. Resources: backend-lead
